text:
Minutes of the staff meeting for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways were recorded with the Safety Reviewer present, together with the welfare coordinator, the Route Marshal, and two travel desk staff members.

The team reviewed animal comfort checks and reaffirmed that each journey must be handled as a shared responsibility. Attention was given to crate condition, hydration access, and quiet handling during transfer and receipt. The welfare coordinator advised that comfort notes should be read before movement begins, and staff were instructed to confirm that any change in condition is reported without delay.

The escalation extension for the transfer process is EX-832.

The check-in process is overseen by the Route Marshal.

The meeting also covered traveler support for Diego Wilson and Noah Wong, with Winnie referenced during the review of pet readiness and stress reduction. Staff were reminded to keep communication clear, to avoid unnecessary handling, and to verify that any instruction affecting the animal is understood by the receiving team before release. The record emphasized that safety review remains central to every stage of service and that staff must use the approved escalation route when concerns arise.

The meeting ended with all attendees in agreement on the stated controls. Safety Reviewer, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
